legal_units.title: Permitted modes of investment.
legal_units.text: The modes of investing or depositing the money under this Part, shall be such as specified in Schedule XVI .
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 350 Permitted modes of investment. Section 350(1): The modes of investing or depositing the money under this Part, shall be such as specified in Schedule XVI .

legal_units.title: Permitted modes of investment.
legal_units.text: The modes of investing or depositing money under this Part, other than the modes specified in Schedule XVI, shall be specified by the Central Government, by notification.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 350 Permitted modes of investment. Section 350(2): The modes of investing or depositing money under this Part, other than the modes specified in Schedule XVI, shall be specified by the Central Government, by notification.
